name: Listen Labs
description: Browse your Listen Labs studies, pull response data, review study designs, and surface analysis insights directly from Claude. Make Listen Labs a native part of your research workflow, an AI-powered research assistant that helps you synthesize qualitative findings faster, with deeper insight.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Listen Labs to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Listen Labs to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://listenlabs.ai/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Listen Labs MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Listen Labs provides these MCP tools: list_studies, get_study_responses, get_response, get_study_analysis, and search_across_studies.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Listen Labs?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Listen Labs in productivity on the Manufact MCP catalog include Autodesk Product Help, BoardWise, FlagStat, Keenable Web Search, and PomoDial.

_published_faq.name: Does Listen Labs MCP require authentication?

acceptedAnswer.text: Listen Labs requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Listen Labs is developed by Listen Labs. It is listed as partner on the Claude connector directory.
